name: Yorna Mishigure
description: Yorna Mishigure is the Third ranking Divine General of the Sacred Vollachia Empire and the ruler of the Demon City of Chaosflame. Harboring the reincarnated soul of Iris from the era of Emperor Eugard Vollachia, she is also the birth mother of Priscilla Barielle. Deeply cherished by her people and fiercely protective of her city, she plays a central supporting role throughout Arc 7 and Arc 8.
